mapper.sql: id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, job_id, project_id, job_type, status, resource_class, progress, current_step, error_code, requested_by_user_id, billed_to_user_id, story_version_id, chapter_id, chapter_row_version, source_hash, source_text, source_language, idempotency_key, storyboard_revision_id, media_plan_id, media_plan_revision, production_mode, content_variant_id, source_variant_id, target_language
mapper.select: INSERT INTO generation_jobs (job_id, project_id, job_type, status, resource_class, progress, current_step, error_code, requested_by_user_id, billed_to_user_id, story_version_id, chapter_id, chapter_row_version, source_hash, source_text, source_language, idempotency_key, storyboard_revision_id, media_plan_id, media_plan_revision, production_mode, content_variant_id, source_variant_id, target_language) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{projectId}, #{type}, #{status}, #{resourceClass}, #{progress}, #{currentStep}, #{errorCode}, #{requestedByUserId}, #{billedToUserId}, #{storyVersionId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterRowVersion}, #{sourceHash}, #{sourceText}, #{sourceLanguage}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{storyboardRevisionId}, #{mediaPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{mediaPlanRevision}, #{productionMode}, #{contentVariantId}, #{sourceVariantId}, #{targetLanguage}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_jobs SET job_id = #{jobId}, project_id = #{projectId}, job_type = #{type}, status = #{status}, resource_class = #{resourceClass}, progress = #{progress}, current_step = #{currentStep}, error_code = #{errorCode}, requested_by_user_id = #{requestedByUserId}, billed_to_user_id = #{billedToUserId}, story_version_id = #{storyVersionId}, chapter_id = #{chapterId}, chapter_row_version = #{chapterRowVersion}, source_hash = #{sourceHash}, source_text = #{sourceText}, source_language = #{sourceLanguage}, idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}, storyboard_revision_id = #{storyboardRevisionId}, media_plan_id = #{mediaPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, media_plan_revision = #{mediaPlanRevision}, production_mode = #{productionMode}, content_variant_id = #{contentVariantId}, source_variant_id = #{sourceVariantId}, target_language = #{targetLanguage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT j.id, j.row_version, j.created_at, j.updated_at, j.job_id, j.project_id, j.job_type, j.status, j.resource_class, j.progress, j.current_step, j.error_code, j.requested_by_user_id, j.billed_to_user_id, j.story_version_id, j.chapter_id, j.chapter_row_version, j.source_hash, j.source_text, j.source_language, j.idempotency_key, j.storyboard_revision_id, j.media_plan_id, j.media_plan_revision, j.production_mode, j.content_variant_id, j.source_variant_id, j.target_language FROM generation_jobs j JOIN projects p ON p.id = j.project_id WHERE j.id = #{id} AND p.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL
